d.tensionArithmetic: Table (h_cache regs/lane = N_PAD*BV*128/(warps*32) fp32; SMEM "park" is N/A in practice -- no Triton primitive to put a non-tl.dot accumulator in SMEM). MEASURED ptxas (wp5hsu63v, GB10 triton3.6 cu130, today): C0 BV16/w8/N16=254 regs/0 spill FITS; C1 BV32/w4/N2=140/0; C2 BV32/w4/N4=235/0; C3 BV32/w4/N16(native-geom)=255-clamped/636B HARD SPILL (still launches); C4 BV32/w8/N16=255/96B (still spills, w8!=w4 wrong tree). Key rows: BV32/w4/N16 = 512 pred regs -> SPILLS (native geom, the only by-construction native-bit-exact, but spills); BV16/w8/N16 (DEPLOYED) = 128 pred / 254 meas / 0 spill / FITS / native-match UNKNOWN (must gate, BV16!=BV32); BV16/w4/N16 = 256 regs SPILLS (this is the OLD verdict's 'spill' row -- it is the 4-warp case, NOT deployed); BV4/w4/N16 = 32KB/64 regs/lane / NO spill / fits-32KB-SMEM / but NOT native (re-warps, see bv4Verdict). Bit-exact CANDIDATES (reproduce native [1,4]/[1,32]/[4,1] K-tree) require BV=32 AND warps=4 by construction = EXACTLY native = SPILLS at N_PAD16. That one line IS the tension: native-bit-exact <=> BV32/w4 <=> spills at deepest deployed tree.
d.bv4Verdict: NO -- BV=4/warps=4 does NOT preserve native's reduction and the lead is OVERSTATED. Native's reduce is over tensor<32x128xf32,#blocked> with sizePerThread=[1,4] threadsPerWarp=[1,32] warpsPerCTA=[4,1] (read from live ttgir fused_sigmoid_gating ...kernel.ttgir; both tt.reduce axis=1 = K). The K-LANE map ([1,4] = 4 K-elems/lane, 32 lanes on K) is the same for any BV since K=128 is fixed -- so the task's intuition is not crazy. At BV=4/w4: M=4>=W=4 so warps DO fit on rows (warpsPerCTA=[4,1]), naively same K-layout. BUT it fails native-match on two grounds: (1) bug-class #10 -- it is a DIFFERENT TENSOR SHAPE ([4,128] vs native [32,128]) = a different compilation/ptxas instruction-selection of the in-thread 4-elem partial-sum + the FMA feeding the reduce; cloning native's tree means compiling native's SHAPE (BV=32), and BV=4 clones nothing native ran + has ZERO banked bit-exact evidence (the banked 0.0 is at BV=16). (2) at BV=4/w8 the listed alt: M=4<W=8 forces 4 warps onto K -> warpsPerCTA=[4,2] -> cross-warp K reduction = definitively different op-order. No-spill arithmetic (b) is TRUE (32KB/64 regs) but irrelevant since the DEPLOYED BV16/w8 is ALSO spill-free (254 regs). Perf (c): BV4 = cdiv(128,4)=32 programs = 8x native's 4, 4x deployed's 8, on the latency-bound scan critical path x48 GDN layers, no batch to amortize at B=1 = WORST perf. Reject on both bit-exact AND speed; fall to recompute-from-spine.
